sources.description: April 25, 2026 - Coverage of the re-arrest of Hayam El Gamal and her five children by ICE just days after a federal judge ordered their release. Details on the 10-month detention at Dilley facility, medical neglect allegations, and the emergency motion to block deportation.
sources.label: The Guardian - Egyptian Family of Six Taken Back into ICE Custody Days After Release

sources.description: April 25, 2026 - Comprehensive coverage of the El Gamal family's re-arrest and subsequent release after judicial intervention. Includes details on the 10-month detention, court rulings by Judge Fred Biery and Magistrate Judge Elizabeth Chestney, and the family's statements about treatment at Dilley.
sources.label: Texas Tribune - ICE Releases El Gamal Family After Re-Arresting Mother and 5 Children

sources.description: April 25, 2026 - Coverage of the family's re-arrest and attempt to deport them to Egypt on a private plane. Reports on emergency appeal to Fifth Circuit and DHS spokesperson's statement about the family as 'national security threats.'
sources.label: Texas Public Radio - ICE Re-Arrests Egyptian Family After Texas Judges Freed Them
